scope: Exercise the direct AC1032 ATTDEF writer route with embedded MTEXT, alongside the already qualified INSERT-owned ATTRIB route, across whole-file allocation failures, same-codec retry, and fresh typed readback.

source.profile: One INSERT-owned multiline ATTRIB (type 2) plus one direct ATTDEF with embedded two-paragraph MTEXT (type 4), emitted to AC1032 ASCII and Binary. No external DWG/DXF fixture is used or added.

implementation.method: Extend the focused AC1032 transaction profile to call public writeAttdef() for a multiline ATTDEF in addition to writeInsert() for the ATTRIB. For each encoding, calibrate the whole dxfRW::write allocation count, inject failures at each measured offset, check the destination sentinel and every initialized caller ATTRIB/ATTDEF/MTEXT field, then retry the same codec and require byte-identical output and readback of both embedded payloads and their type values.
